summary: This Form 6-K by Karooooo Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reports its Q4 and full-year FY2026 unaudited financial results along with a declared USD1.50 dividend per share (20% increase YoY). The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. It highlights record subscription revenue, ARR growth, and FY2027 outlook with EPS growth of 21%. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situations event is present. This is a standard periodic financial update.
